v: Ha juntzanh sb'it winhaj Salomón, manhxo jantakok swach'il yalji. Syalan ix kob'es:
Ach kelem xajanab'il wuuj, tz'ub'elta jab'ok in ti'. Te wach' swab' t'a yichanh yal uwa.
Te wach' yel a jab' yuj yal suk'uk'i sjab' ayoch t'ayach. Ayik swab'an a b'inaji, lajan wal icha suk'uk'i sjab' chi'. Yuj chi' te xajan ach yuj heb' ix ix.

Ik'inb'at t'a a pat ach in reyal, ik'inb'at het'ok elanhchamel, xchi ix. Syalan heb' anima: Te tzalajk'olal kajek' het'ok, ol ko nakot b'aj tzonh a xajanej yujto te wach' t'a yichanh yal uwa. Tob'an yuj chi' te xajan ach yuj heb' ix ix tik, xchi heb'. Syalan ix kob'es:

Ex ix aj Jerusalén, a in tik k'ik' ch'uminak wilji, palta te wach' wilji. K'ik'okab' wilji icha yilji smantiado heb' aj Cedar, palta te wach' wilji icha yilji k'apak cortina ayoch t'a yol spat winhaj Salomón.

Manh ex och wal k'elan t'ayin, yujto k'ik' ch'uminak wilji, yujto tz'anak in niwanil yuj yok k'u. Ha heb' winh in nulej ix kot yowal heb' winh t'ayin, ix in yak'anoch heb' winh tanhwoj uwa, haxo ix aji, maj in ya'ilej in b'a.

Ach kelem xajanab'il wuuj, al t'ayin ¿b'ajtil tza tanhwej nok' a kalnel? ¿B'ajtil tzik'b'at nok' yik' yip t'a chimk'ualil? ¿Tas yuj ol in satek' ach in say t'a skal juntzanhxo heb' tanhwum kalnel? xchi ix. Syalan heb' anima:

Tato manh ojtakok ach ix te wach' ilji t'a skal heb' ix ix wach' yilji, ochanh tzak'an yuj yoklem nok' kalnel chi'. Tanhwej wa nok' yunetak a chiwa t'a slak'anil slechpat heb' winh tanhwum kalnel chi', xchi heb'. Syalan winh kelem:
Ach kob'es xajanab'il wuuj, te wach' ilji swila', icha wal yilji nok' kob'es chej stok'an scarruaje winh sreyal Egipto.
Te wach' yilji spak'ultak a ti' t'a skal k'een uchikin, te wach' pax yilji a jaj b'aj ayoch k'een a tonh.
Ol ko b'o k'een uchikin nab'a oro, ol kak'och k'een plata yelwanub'ok, xchi winh. Syalan ix kob'es:
Yakb'an k'ojanem winh rey t'a smexa, haxo anh nardo sumumi yel sjab' t'ayin.
Ach kelem xajanab'il wuuj, lajan ach wal icha junok yub'anh te' mirra suk'uk'i sjab' ayek' t'a skal wim.
Ach xajanab'il wuuj, lajan ach icha junok yub'anh xumakil te alheña sk'ib' t'a skal te' uwa awab'il t'a En-gadi, xchi ix. Syalan winh kelem:
Te wach' ilji ach kob'es xajanab'il wuuj, wal yel te wach' ilji. Lajan swach'il yilji yol a sat icha yilji yol sat nok' paramuch, xchi winh. Syalan ix kob'es:
Te wach' ilji ach kelem xajanab'il wuuj, wal yel te wach' ilji. Ha wal anh yax ank'ultak ol och ko waynub'ok, xchi ix. Syalan winh kelem:
Ha spatzab'il ko pat ayochi nab'a a te' k'ute', haxo te' tzikap ayoch t'a yib'anh, xchi winh.
Lajan in icha junok anh xumak t'a sch'olanil yik Sarón, icha anh chochol sk'ib' t'a ak'lik, xchi ix. Syalan winh kelem:
T'a skal heb' ix yetixal ix xajanab'il wuuj, lajan ix icha junok anh xumak t'a skal te' k'iix, xchi winh. Syalan ix kob'es:
T'a skal heb' yetkelemal winh xajanab'il wuuj, lajan winh icha junok te' mansan ay t'a kaltak te'. Manh jantakok swach'il wem k'ojan t'a yenhul, te chi' sat te' swab'i.
Ix in yik'b'at winh t'a spatil niwak wael, t'a smasanil sk'ol winh ix sch'oxo' to xajan in yuj.
Ak' te' takinh sat uwa t'ayin yik tz'och wip, a wal te' mansan tzak' in lo yik sikb'i in k'ool, yujto tzin cham ach in nib'ani.
Ha sk'ab' winh t'a sk'exanh syak'och t'a yalanh in jolom, haxo swach' winh tzin lak'ank'ei, xchi ix. Syalan winh kelem:
Ex kob'estak aj Jerusalén, tzin tewi wal t'ayex to manh he pitzel swayanh ix xajanab'il wuuj, munil ol el swayanh ix, xchi winh. Syalan ix kob'es:
A... wan sjawi winh xajanab'il wuuj. Tzaxo wab' yoch sjaj winh. Sk'e wal chennaj winh skot t'a jolomtak witz. Sk'e wal chennaj winh sjawi t'a tzalkixtak.
Ha winh xajanab'il wuuj, lajan winh icha nok' ch'ukul, icha wal junok yune' ch'ukul chi'. Ayxoek' winh t'a patik pat tik, t'anhanxooch winh t'a yolanil wentena.
Ha winh xajanab'il wuuj chi', ix yal winh t'ayin icha tik: K'eanh waan ach xajanab'il wuuj, kotanh ach nib'ab'il wuuj.
Inai, toxo ix ek'b'at sk'ual siknhab'.
Ayxo anh xumak t'a kaltak te', toxo ix k'och stiempoal yoch b'it, tzaxo kab' yoch sjaj nok' kuwajte' t'a tik.
Ayxo sat te' higo, sumumi yel sjab' te' uwa. K'eanh waan ach xajanab'il wuuj, ach to te wach' ilji, kotanh, xchi winh t'ayin, xchi ix. Syalan winh kelem:
Ach xajanab'il wuuj, lajan ach icha nok' paramuch sk'ub'ej sb'a t'a sattak k'een. Ch'ox a sat wila'', lolonanh jab'ok wab'i, yujto te wach'tzin a loloni, te wach'pax ilji.
Pechek nok' waax yet' nok' yune', to syixtej te' kuwa nok', icha te' wanto yak'an xumakil, xchi winh. Syalan ix kob'es:
Yik in winh xajanab'il wuuj, wik pax winh, stanhwi kalnel winh t'a skal anh xumak.

Yakb'an manta ik' t'a k'inhib'alil, ayik manto sakb'i, meltzajanhkot t'ayin ach xajanab'il wuuj. Lajan tzutej a b'a icha junok nok' ch'ukul, icha nok' kelem ch'ukul toxonhej sk'e chennaj skot t'a tzalkixtak, xchi ix.
Ha t'a sat in ch'at t'ak'walil, ix in wayichej in sayanek' winh xajanab'il wuuj. Ix in sayek' winh, palta maj ilchaj winh wuuj.
Slajwi chi', ix in k'e waan, ix in ek' in say winh t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Tzin sayanek' winh xajanab'il wuj t'a yoltak calle yet' t'a yoltak mercado. Ix in saynhej winh, palta maj ilchaj winh wuuj.
Ix in k'anb'an t'a heb' policía tzek' stanhwej chonhab' chi': ¿Maj am eyil winh xajanab'il wuuj? xin chi.

Kenanto wal tzin b'at t'a heb' winh chi', ix ilchaj winh xajanab'il wuuj. Ix in och ketzketz t'a sk'ab' winh, majxo waktejel-laj winh. Ix wik'anb'at winh t'a spat ix in nun, t'a scuarto ix in nun chi' b'aj in alji, xchi ix. Syalan winh kelem.
Ex kob'estak aj Jerusalén, tzin tewi wal t'ayex to manh he pitzel swayanh ix xajanab'il wuuj, munil ol el swayanh ix, xchi winh. Syalan heb' anima
¿Tas jun skot t'a tzinan lum chi', t'a skal jun topanh tab' skoti, haton t'a skal stab'il mirra yet' incienso yet' masanil makan suk'uk'i sjab' chonhb'il yuj heb' chonhwajum?
Haton b'aj sb'akhchajek' winhaj Salomón. Oyanoch 60 soldado t'a spatik, haton wal juntzanh heb' winh soldado te jelan t'a skal heb' israel.
Masanil juntzanh heb' winh chi', a k'een espada syak'lab'ej heb' winh, te jelan heb' winh t'a owal. Junjun heb' winh ayoch yespada t'a snanhal, tato ay tas ay smay tzek' t'ak'walil.
Ha winhaj Salomón ix sb'o jun b'aj sb'akhchajek' t'a te te' wach' ay t'a Líbano.

Ha yoyal, nab'a plata, haxo yijnub' yich, nab'a oro. Ha b'aj tz'em k'ojan winh, a anh púrpura ayoch t'ay. T'a yol chi' ayoch yelwanub' b'ob'il yuj heb' ix aj Jerusalén, yuj sch'oxani to xajan winh yuj heb' ix.
Ex ix aj Sion, elanhekb'at eyil winhaj rey Salomón. Ayk'e scorona winh, haton jun ix yak'k'e ix snun winh t'a sjolom t'a sk'ual snupnaji, haton jun k'u b'aj ix te tzalaj sk'ol winh, xchi heb'.

Te wach' ilji ach xajanab'il wuuj, yelxo wal te wach' ilji. Ha yol a sat chekel t'a spatik smusil a sat lajan yilji icha yol sat nok' paramuch. Ha xil a jolom, lajan wal yilji icha yemta nhililok nok' chiwa t'a pak'an yik Galaad.
Haxo k'een e, te wach' yilji k'een, lajan yilji k'een icha yilji nok' kalnel sb'ikji ayik toxo sjoxji. Tz'akan k'een, malaj junok k'een malaj yetb'eyum, icha nok' nun kalnel junnhej sb'ey yet' yune'.
Chaktz'ob'inak a ti' icha chakchak ch'al. Sat in k'ool yuj swach'il a loloni. Haxo spak'ultak a ti' musan yuj junok k'apak, icha wal yilji k'axepok te' granada.
Ha wal a jaj, lajan wal icha torre b'ob'il yuj winhaj rey David, lokjab'och mil maklab' jul-lab' yik heb' soldado jelan t'a spatiktak yelwanub'ok.
Ha im schab'il, lajan wal yilji icha chawanhok yunetak ch'ukul tiox swa t'a skaltak anh chochol.
Yakb'an manta ik' t'a k'inhib'alil, ayik manto sakb'i, ol in b'at t'a jolomtak witz b'aj ay anh mirra, t'a tzalkixtak b'aj suk'uk'i sjab'.
Te wach' ilji ach xajanab'il wuuj, te wach' yilji a niwanil smasanil, te malaj jab'ok a paltail.

Ach to ol ach och wetb'eyumok, konh el t'a Líbano, konh el t'a jolom witz Líbano. Ol ko puklaj ko b'a yet' jolom witz Amana tik, yet' jolom witz Senira. Ol kaktejkan witz Hermón, b'aj ay snhak'een nok' choj yet' b'aj ay nok' leopardo.

Ach xajanab'il wuuj, ol ach och wetb'eyumok, toxo ix kan in gana t'ayach, yujnhej to ix ach kot k'elan junel t'ayin, ix wilan jun ch'anhal tonh lokanoch t'a a jaj. Junelnhej ix mutz'mutz'an a sat t'ayin. Icha chi' ix aj yik'ji in pixan uuj.
Ach ix ol ach och wetb'eyumok, manh jantakok swach'il in a xajanani, yelxo te wach' t'a yichanh wino. Yelxo te wach' a perfume tza k'an t'a yichanh masanil tas sumumi sjab'.
Ach ol ach och wetb'eyumok, icha yalchab' ayoch t'a a ti', icha wal yalchab' yet' lech ay t'a yol a ti'. Icha suk'uk'ial sjab' Líbano, icha wal chi' sjab' a pichul.
Ach ol ach och wetb'eyumok, lajan ach icha junok awb'en makan, icha sjaj ha ha' to makan, te wach' yaj smakchaji.
Lajan ach icha junok awb'en b'aj swolan te' granado, a sat tas awab'il ta' manh jantakok schi'al, ay pax anh alheña,
anh nardo, anh azafrán yet' juntzanh te wale' suk'uk'i sjab', te' canela yet' masanil makanhil te' incienso, mirra yet' pax áloes, masanil tastak te wach' yel sjab'.
Lajan ach pax icha sjaj ha ha' t'a skal tas awab'il, haton ha' sk'eul sjaj tz'emta t'a Líbano, xchi winh.

Ha ik' skot t'a stojolal norte yet' ik' skot t'a stojolal sur, ek'okab' xumumok t'a skal wawb'en, yik wach' sb'eyb'at suk'uk'ial sjab'. Syalan ix kob'es: Kotanh ach xajanab'il wuuj, ochanh t'a wawb'en, tza loan sat tas awab'il manh jantakok schi'al, xchi ix.

Wan woch t'a skal wawb'en ach wetb'eyum xajanab'il wuuj. Wan wik'ank'e in mirra yet' in perfume, wan wab'lan schab'il nok' akanh, wan wuk'an in wino yet' in lech, xchi winh. Syalan heb' amigo t'a heb' chawanh: Ex amigo waanhek, uk'ek ha', uk'ek jantak tze nib'ej, xchi heb'. Syalan ix kob'es:

Waynak in b'ati, palta pitzan in pixan, ix wab'ani to a winh xajanab'il wuuj tz'awaj t'a puerta: Ach kob'es xajanab'il wuuj, jakin ochi. Lajan ach icha nok' paramuch, malaj jab'ok a paltail. Te ch'ayan in jolom yuj yal ak'wal. Tz'el wal jililjok yal ak'wal chi' t'a xil in jolom, xchi winh t'ayin.
Toxo ix wik'el in pichul, ¿tom ol wak'och junelxo? Toxo ix in b'ik wok, ochtapax pokok t'ay junelxo, xin chi t'a winh.
Ha winh xajanab'il wuuj chi', ix yak'ochta sk'ab' winh t'a yolanil puerta. Ix in k'e wal juknaj yuj.
Yuj chi' ix in k'e waan in jakochta winh. Toxonhej ix el t'ujuljok mirra t'a in k'ab', ix ochkan t'a spatiktak sch'apul puerta.

Ha wal yik ix wab'an slolon winh, ijan ix in cham ix wab'i. Ayik ix in jakan puerta t'a winh xajanab'il wuuj chi', manhxo ayok ek'laj winh. Ix in sayek' winh, majxo chaxlaj winh wuuj. Ix wawtej winh, palta majxo tak'woklaj winh t'ayin.
Ix in ilchajel yuj heb' winh stanhwan chonhab'. Ix in smak'an lajwok heb' winh. Te chukxonhej ix aj yik'anel in xotil heb' winh stanhwan spuertail chonhab' chi'.
Ex kob'estak aj Jerusalén, ak'ek he ti': Tato tz'ilchaj winh in xajanab'il eyuuj, alek t'a winh to wan in cham in naan winh, xin chi t'a heb' ix.

Ix yalan heb' ix kob'estak chi' t'ayin: ¿Tas swach'il winh a xajanab'il chi' t'ayach, ach ix te wach' ilji t'a yichanh heb' ix ix wach' yilji? ¿Tas wal swach'il jun winh xajan chi' uuj, yuj chi' tza k'an t'ayonh to skak' ko ti'? xchi heb' ix t'ayin.
Ha winh xajanab'il wuuj chi', sak winh, chakwasinak yilji winh, te wach' yilji winh t'a yichanh lajunhe' mil winak.
Ha sat winh, lajan yet' k'een oro te wach'. Ha xil sjolom winh kolochtak, k'ik' yilji icha nok' joj.
Ha yol sat winh, lajan icha nok' paramuch tzek' t'a titak ha', ichato t'a skal lech tz'achanwi nok', t'a sti' snhajab'il ha ha' chi' tz'em manhan nok'.
Ha spak'ultak sti' winh, icha wal junok awb'en b'aj ay anh xumak te wach' sjab'. Ha sti' winh, lajan wal icha junok anh xumak te wach' sjab'.
Ha sk'ab' winh, lajan icha junok suyanh k'een oro ayoch k'een topacio t'ay. Ha sk'ool winh, icha wal k'een marfil nhululixonhej, te ayoch k'een zafiro yelwanub'ok.
Ha wal yok winh, lajan wal icha chab'ok oy nab'a mármol ayem t'a yib'anh chab'ok yich to nab'a oro te wach'. Lajan yilji winh icha te' k'ute' ay t'a Líbano, to sik'b'ileli.
Ha wal slolonel winh syala', te chi' skab'i, te wach'nhej winh t'a smasanil. Icha wal chi' yilji winh in xajanab'il chi' ex kob'estak aj Jerusalén, xin chi t'a heb' ix.
Ach ix te wach' ilji t'a yichanh heb' ix ix wach' yilji, ¿b'ajtil ix k'och winh xajanab'il chi' uuj? ¿B'ajwaltil ix b'at winh yik wach' b'at ko say winh? xchi heb' t'ayin. Syalan ix kob'es:
Ha winh xajanab'il chi' wuuj, toxo ix b'at winh b'aj ay yawb'en, t'a skal tas awab'il yuj winh to suk'uk'i yel sjab'. Ix b'at winh yak' tzalajb'ok sk'ool yet' smolan te' xumak.
Ha in tik, yik in winh xajanab'il wuuj chi', wik pax winh. Syak' tzalajb'ok sk'ol winh t'a skal te' xumak chi', xchi ix. Syalan winh kelem:
Ach ix xajanab'il wuuj, te wach' ilji, nib'ab'ilxonhej ilji icha wal yilji chonhab' Tirsa yet' chonhab' Jerusalén. Ayxo smay yilji, icha juntzanh soldado sb'ey t'a stzolal.
Manhxookab' mutz'mutz'an a sat t'ayin, yujto toxo ix ik'ji in pixan uuj. Ha xil a jolom, lajan yilji icha yemta nhililok nok' chiwa t'a pak'an yik Galaad.
Ha k'een e, toxonhej stz'ilili k'een. Lajan yilji k'een icha nok' kalnel toto tz'elta b'aj sb'ikjieli, chatakwanh sb'ey nok' yet' yune', malaj junok nok' to sch'okoj.
Ha wal spak'ultak a ti' musan yuj junok k'apak, ichaxonhej yilji k'axepok te' granada.
Tzalajokab' winh rey yet' 60 heb' ix yetb'eyum reina yaji yet' 80 heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum yet' pax heb' ix kob'estak maxtzak b'ischaji.

Palta a in tik, junnhej ix wiko'. Lajan ix icha wal nok' paramuch malaj spaltail. Anhej ix xajanab'il yuj snun, yuj chi' malaj junokxo mach lajan icha ix tik yalan snun chi'. Ayik tz'ilji ix yuj heb' ix kob'estak, yuj heb' ix reina, yuj pax heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum winh rey chi', masanil heb' chi' tz'alani to wach' yilji ix, xchi winh. Syalan heb' amigo:

¿Mach jun ix ix sch'ox sb'a chi', icha wal sch'oxan sb'a k'u t'a k'inhib'alil? Wach'xonhej yilji ix icha yilji k'een uj, icha yilji yok k'u, ay smay yilji icha juntzanh soldado sb'ey t'a stzolal, xchi heb'. Syalan ix kob'es:
Ix in b'at b'aj ay te' ch'akte' nogales, yik swilan masanil tas swolan t'a ch'olan. Ix in nib'ej ix wila'' tato wan skan sat te' uwa yet' xumakil te' granado.
Manhxo tok tzin na', icha wal to ayinek' t'a yol carruaje yet' winh wajalil, xchi ix. Syalan heb' amigo:

Meltzajanh, meltzajanh ach Sulamita. Meltzajanh, snib'ej ko k'ol tzonh och k'elan t'ayach, xchi heb'. Syalan ix kob'es: ¿Tas yuj tze nib'ej tzeyil in chanhalwi t'a skal snanhal cha tzol anima tik? xchi ix Sulamita chi'.
Ach kob'es, ach yisil winh rey, manhxo jantakok swach'il yilji ok t'a yol a xanhab'. Ha wal a xub', te wach' yilji icha wal smunlajel junok jelan sb'oan tastak yet' k'een oro.
Ha wal a k'ool, lajan wal icha junok ch'ub' to aynhejem wino t'a yool. Haxo a nanhal, lajan icha junok kunhanh ixim trigo hoyan och te' xumak t'a spatik.
Ha im schab'il, lajan wal icha chawanhok nok' ch'ukul tiox ix aj yalji.

Ha a jaj, lajan wal icha junok torre nab'a marfil. Ha yol a sat, lajan icha chab' ha' nhajab' t'a chonhab' Hesbón, junnhej ay t'a spuertail yik Bat-rabim. Haxo a nhi', lajan wal yet' torre t'a Líbano, haton jun k'elanb'at t'a chonhab' Damasco.
Ha a jolom, chaanh ayk'ei, lajan icha jolom witz Carmelo. Te kopopi yilji xil a jolom icha yilji sch'alil púrpura. Toxonhej tz'ik'jikank'e spixan jun winh rey yuj xil a jolom chi'.
Ach xajanab'il wuuj, ach ix to nib'ab'il, yelxo te wach' ilji.
Te tojol ilji icha junok te' palma. Haxo im, lajan wal icha junjun k'ojlab' sat te' palma chi'.
Tzin nib'ej k'e in b'a t'a te' palma chi' yik swik'anemta te' sat. Ha im lajan wal icha junjun k'ojlab' te' uwa. Ha xob'al a ti', suk'uk'i sjab' icha sjab' te' mansan.
Ha wal a ti', lajan wal icha wino manhxo jantakok swach'il, xchi winh kelem. Syalan ix kob'es: Yuk'okab' wino winh xajanab'il wuuj, tz'och t'a sti' winh, tzek' t'a skal ye winh.
Yik in winh xajanab'il wuuj, te nib'ab'il in yuj winh.
Konh t'a kaltak awb'en ach xajanab'il wuuj, tzek' junok ak'wal kuuj t'a skaltak xumakil anh alheña.
Haxo t'a k'inhib'alil, tzonh b'at t'a skal te' uwa yik skila' tato ayxo swol te', tato wanxo spoj xumakil te'. Ol kila' tato wanxo xumakan te' granado, a wal ta' ol in ch'oxo' to xajan ach wuuj.
Ayxo sjab' anh mandrágora. Ha t'a sti' ko pat, ayxo sat masanil tas awab'il wach' sloji, ay sat takinhxo yet' sat toto smolji. Ch'ok wal ix wik'kanel ik ach xajanab'il wuuj, xchi ix.
Komonok in nulej ach, junnhej am im ix ko tz'ub'u'. Tato icha chi', ayik tzach in chaan t'a yoltak b'e, tzam yal in tz'ub'anelta a ti', malaj am mach tz'alan in pekal.
Tzam yal ach wik'anb'at t'a spat ix in nun, tzam ach wik'och t'a yol pat chi'. Ha ach am wal tzach och in k'ayb'umalok. Ha in am swak' wino manh jantakok swach'il uk'ej yet' yal sat te' in granado.
Ha a k'ab' t'a a k'exanh tzak'och t'a yalanh in jolom, haxo a wach' tzin lak'ank'ei, xchi ix. Syalan winh kelem:
Ex kob'estak aj Jerusalén, ak'ek he ti' t'ayin to manh ol he pitzel swayanh ix xajanab'il wuuj, munil ol el swayanh ix, xchi winh. Syalan heb' amigo:

¿Mach jun ix ix skot t'a tzinan lu'um chi', jichanem ix t'a yib'anh winh xajanab'il yuj? xchi heb'. Syalan winh kelem: Ha t'a yich jun te' mansan ix in xib'tejel a wayanh. Hata' kotnak syail ix a nun ayik aljinak. Syalan ix kob'es:

Mokab' a xajanej junokxo ix ix, palta ainnhejokab'i. Mokab'a junokxo mach tza lak'k'ei, palta ainnhejokab'i. Ha ko xajanb'ail ay yip icha chamel. Icha b'aj smukchaj chamnak to max yaktejel tas yamb'il yuj, icha chi' yaj b'aj sko xajanej ko b'a. Ha b'aj sko xajanej ko b'a, te' k'ak' icha junok k'ak' te ow.

Ha masanil ha' mar max tzak'wan ha' yak'an tup jun k'ak' chi'. Max yalpaxlaj yak'an tup yowal ha' niwak ha'. Tato ay mach syaltej masanil tas ay t'a spat yik smanan jun xajanb'ail tik, tonhej am spatikajkaneli, xchi ix. Syalan heb' winh snulej ix kob'es:
Ay jun ix kanab' tzak'an uninto, mantalaj yim ix. ¿Tas sko k'ulej yet' ix tato sjawi sk'anumal ix?
Tato lajan ix yet' junok muro, tzam ko b'ok'e chab'ok torre plata t'ay. Tato lajan ix icha junok puerta, tzam ko b'o yet' te' chemte' nab'a k'ute', xchi heb' winh. Syalan ix kob'es:
Ha in tik, lajan in icha junok muro. Haxo wim, lajan icha juntzanh torre, yuj chi' stzalaj wal sk'ol winh xajanab'il wuuj wet'ok.
Ha winhaj Salomón, ay jun yawb'en uwa winh t'a Baal-hamón. Syak'kan winh t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanh heb' stanhwumal chi'. Ayik ol molchaj sat te' uwa chi', ol yak' mil k'een plata junjun heb' t'a winh.
Emokab' jun mil k'een splata winhaj Salomón yet' 200 yik heb' stanhwan chi'. Ha inxo jun, ay wawb'en uwa t'a yol wiko', a inxonhej tzin na' tas swutej, xchi ix. Syalan winh kelem:
Ach xajanab'il wuuj, ayach ek' t'a skal awb'en, tzin nib'ej swab' yoch a jaj. Yet' heb' kamigo, snib'ej pax heb' syab' yoch a jaj, xchi winh. Syalan ix kob'es:
Ach xajanab'il wuuj, yelk'olal a koti. K'eanh urnaj icha junok nok' ch'ukul, icha wal junok yune' ch'ukul t'a tzalkixtak b'aj tz'awchaj incienso, xchi ix.
